required_assumptions: s(z) is a unary function symbol
p and q are distinct symbols so the divided difference denominator is non-zero

proof_obligations.expected: G0002 == F(z) with z replaced by p
G0003 == F(z) with z replaced by q
G0001 == first divided difference of F at nodes p and q, i.e. (F(p)-F(q))/(p-q)

hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The catalog expressions are exactly the endpoint evaluations and the first divided difference of a single unspecified unary function. G0002 and G0003 are instances obtained by substituting the nodes p and q into the latent function F(z)=s(z), while G0001 is the first Newton divided difference generated from the same latent function and the same nodes.
